home_rows.title.description: Settings > Libraries row and page title: the page that orders Home's rows and hides some. Short.

home_rows.detail.value: Which rows Home shows, and their order.
home_rows.detail.description: Detail line under the Home rows row on the Settings root. One short sentence.

home_rows.copy.value: OK picks up a row, Up or Down moves it, and OK puts it down. Left or Right shows or hides a row. Each profile keeps its own order.
home_rows.copy.description: Home rows page header copy: how the remote's keys reorder rows and show or hide them; each profile has its own layout. OK, Up, Down, Left and Right are remote keys.

home_rows.shown.description: Home rows page: trailing word of a row Home shows. One word; a row is feminine where the language has gender.

home_rows.hidden.description: Home rows page: trailing word of a row Home leaves out. One word; a row is feminine where the language has gender.

home_rows.moving.description: Home rows page: trailing word of the row being carried to a new place. One word.

home_rows.moving_detail.value: Up or Down to move it, OK to put it down.
home_rows.moving_detail.description: Home rows page: detail line under the row being carried. Up, Down and OK are remote keys.

home_rows.empty.value: Home’s rows appear here once Home has loaded.
home_rows.empty.description: Home rows page: note shown while Home has not loaded any rows yet.
